documentation.content:
No real purchase (order.completed outside the e2e suite) in 23 hours. Nothing failed, which is why no other alert catches it: the checkout may be broken for real users, or the payment webhook may not be arriving. The window is 23 h because alert windows must stay under 24 h.

Disabled until the API has real traffic: today zero purchases a day is normal. Enable it by setting "enabled" to true and running scripts/applyMonitoring.ts.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Webhook-de-Stripe).
